block_disjointness.policy: block-level: a query_idx block is the leakage unit, because the carrier re-renders one base scenario at several tiers. Every block belongs to at most one of the three rosters, by construction and re-proved here

design: EVO-A1 loop roster, roster_role 'construction' (owner decision 2026-09-05): these identities may be read WITH their gold offline, and gold may reach the frozen core only through the text-only 'construction-proposer-text' arm as prompt artifacts, never answers. split_role stays 'discovery', the TRAIN90 precedent. Block-disjoint from the Audio2Tool exposure union, from the reserved A2T-FRESH-800-V1, and from the other two EVO rosters.

exposure_union.note: Union of every committed EVALUATION identity of the audio2tool carrier: probe-sample receipts, additive D1 media supplements, and roster-v1 receipts whose roster_role is 'evaluation'. Construction-role rosters are excluded by design (owner decision 2026-09-05: construction identities may be read with their gold labels, evaluation identities never can).

owner_decision: owner 2026-09-06, RELAXED with sentinels: a MF-1 target survives when the GOLD side of its dominant miss direction has construction capacity, and a thin tool is kept as a harm sentinel rather than dropped. Supersedes SAEA-SN-MF-A2T-EVO-FOLD-ROSTERS-V1, whose receipts stay as history.

pool.source: the V3 exposure-free construction pool, runtime wav at most 60 s

sample_selection_rule: one wav per (tier, query_idx) unit: the unit's lowest manifest id, which is the release's own first-successful-speaker pick
sentinel_rule: thin tool (fold_quota 0): keep min(4, units // 2) exemplar units, paid from the smallest blocks first, and split every remaining BLOCK evenly between fold A and fold B as HARM SENTINELS, the odd block to fold A. A sentinel row is never a reward row: it is counted in the confirmation's background bound and in the round receipt's per-target sentinel-harms line
